lines.text: Some writing seems designed to keep you out.
You read it once. Then again. And you're still not sure what it says.
Plainly fixes that. Select the text, in any app, and press one shortcut.
A small card opens right beside it, and explains it in plain words.
Same meaning. Every number, date and name kept. Just a lot easier to read.
Need it simpler? Or just untangled? You pick how plain.
It works wherever you can select text. A paper in your browser. A letter in your inbox.
It translates, too. Into Bangla, Spanish, Hindi, and many more.
The AI runs on your own computer, so what you read with it stays there. It even works offline.
Look up any word, and keep the ones worth remembering.
And it checks its own work. If a number goes missing, the card tells you.
